start.intro: New here? A short tour shows in seven steps where to find what – it changes nothing in your data.

offer.title: Take a quick tour?
offer.text: Seven short steps show you where to find things. You can also start it any time later from the help page.

triage.title: Triage: capture first, sort later
triage.capture: Whatever comes to mind, throw it without thinking into the Quick Dump: the + in the bar on the left or the key C. It doesn't go anywhere yet, it lands as a card here in Triage.
triage.capturePhone: Whatever comes to mind, throw it into the Quick Dump without thinking: the + at the bottom centre, hold it to speak. It lands as a card here in Triage.
triage.decide: When you have time, decide card by card: <kbd>→</kbd> task, <kbd>←</kbd> discard, <kbd>D</kbd> note, <kbd>T</kbd> with a date, <kbd>Space</kbd> later – or use the buttons below the card, including “To list”.
triage.decidePhone: When you have time, decide card by card: swipe right to make it a task, left to discard it. The buttons below put it on a list, into a note or give it a date.

notes.title: Notes made of blocks
notes.text: Every note is an outline of bullets. Type <kbd>/</kbd> in a bullet and the menu turns it into another block: heading, to-do, numbered list, code, callout, table – or with <kbd>/canvas</kbd> a drawing with shapes, arrows and freehand.
notes.empty: No note yet? The plus at the top of the sidebar creates your first one.
notes.phoneList: Tap a note to open it; the + at the bottom creates a new one.

linked.title: Linked tasks
linked.text: The check icon to the right of a to-do in a note turns it into a real task. It then also shows up under Tasks – with due date, Kanban and reminder – and stays linked to the bullet: ticking and the title sync both ways, to-dos right below it become subtasks.
linked.badge: The “{{badge}}” badge on the bullet opens the task, “{{back}}” on the task jumps back.

focus.title: Full screen for writing
focus.button: This button starts focus mode: just the note, across the whole window (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>⇧</kbd>+<kbd>F</kbd>). <kbd>Esc</kbd> brings everything back.
focus.menu: In the note’s ⋯ menu, “{{item}}” starts full screen: just the note, across the whole window.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.text: Switch between list, Kanban and calendar here. Clicking a task opens the details with due date, subtasks, notes and reminders.
tasks.textPhone: Choose list, Kanban or calendar in the menu behind the logo at the top left. Tapping a task opens the details with due date, subtasks, notes and reminders.

search.title: Search
search.text: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> (Mac: <kbd>⌘</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd>) or <kbd>/</kbd> opens the search from anywhere. It finds notes down to a single bullet, tasks and list items.
search.textPhone: The magnifier at the top opens the search. It finds notes down to a single bullet, tasks and list items.

end.title: That’s it!
end.text: Everything else – shortcuts, lists, sharing and more – is here on the help page (the ? at the bottom of the bar on the left). “Start tour” shows the tour again any time.
end.textPhone: Everything else – lists, sharing and more – is here on the help page (through your profile picture at the top right). “Start tour” shows the tour again any time.
end.share: By the way, you can share notes, task lists and lists with others and edit them together.
